abstract: A conformance tool must decide which version of a specification a document is written to before it can say whether the document is valid, and that decision is usually invisible in the number it reports. We census every public A2A agent card reachable from a stated frame of 2,164 x402 seller hosts on Base. 663 serve a card and 661 parsed on 2026-10-12, across the current and the pre-0.3 well-known path. Judged strictly against each document's attributed version, with no requirement waived, 311 are valid, 297 invalid, and 53 assert nothing our rule recognises as an A2A claim and receive no verdict. We report the route by which each version was attributed, separating documents that declare a version (214, 11.7% invalid), that declare one version while carrying a key only another defines (98, 42.9%), and that declare none at all (296, 77.7%). The last rate has a mechanical driver we name rather than hide: 219 of its 230 failures include the missing version field and 95 include nothing else. For every document whose version was not simply declared, we also grade it against the version not assigned and publish the complete transition table: 110 of 394 change verdict, 73 in one direction and 37 in the other. Separately, 189 documents are valid against their attributed version and fail a required-field check that assumes the newest version, which is the method of the one comparable published measurement. We state the validation contract, publish the frame, the documents, the per-document verdicts and the checker, and make no claim that any attribution reflects publisher intent.
author: adctx
change_summary: Full revision after rejection. (1) The central claim is withdrawn: a missing protocolVersion is restored as a violation even where the version was inferred from its absence, because attribution and validation answer different questions and protocolVersion is in 0.3's own required list. Strict counts are now 311 valid / 297 invalid / 53 unclassified, replacing 406/201/54. (2) The relaxed reading survives only as a separately named per-document field, tolerant_valid, never as a verdict. (3) The complete alternative-version transition table replaces the one-directional 38: 110 of 394 change verdict, 73 one way and 37 the other. (4) version_source gains a fourth value, conflict, for the 98 documents that declare one version and carry a key only another defines; the declared/conflict/inferred rates are reported separately rather than as one declared-versus-inferred split. (5) A JSON-LD @context naming the A2A vocabulary is now read as a declaration, which reclassifies one previously excluded document and makes the unclassified set 53. (6) Two checker defects fixed: a relaxation that swallowed a wrongly typed protocolVersion, and skills[].tags items never being type-checked. (7) The 2,164-host frame with per-path status codes is published, and the short-circuit that makes path overlap unobservable is stated as a limit. (8) A validation contract section documents what is checked, what is not, and how version families are collapsed. (9) References [7] and [8] added. The abstract's earlier claim that attribution decides 'a third of the conformance rate' is dropped; no such aggregate claim is made.
title: A version-attributed census of 661 public A2A agent cards, with the sensitivity of every verdict to the attribution
